isolation: Existing mutation/add/remove tests passed under new IDs. Selected real builds preserve other unit files/hashes/mtimes. Each job retains own source/Spark/requirements/artifacts/deploy references.
limits: Spark processing is stubbed; real Glue/Spark/Athena/Iceberg and managed-runtime execution remain unvalidated.
SQL ZIP/resource loading is proved offline; dbt project and external Python dependencies remain separate runtime requirements.
Future deploy with jobs idle; Git rollback does not roll back data/schema/state.
provenance: Build/smoke manifest records the honest pre-commit snapshot (baseline + dirty=true); source_inputs.json and artifact hashes identify exact inputs/bytes. The local commit containing this evidence is the final change; post-commit rebuild checks the same hashes without a circular evidence commit.
